items.d: 54 plants × 3,465g Artisan Wine every 7 days ≈ 26,800g/day passive. Peak endgame income — requires Greenhouse + Kegs + Artisan profession.
33 Kegs × Starfruit Wine (6,300g Artisan) per 7-day batch = 207,900g/batch. Best single-season burst income.
8 Pigs × ~2 Truffles/day × 1,491g Artisan Oil = ~23,000g/day in clear weather. Fully passive with Auto-Petter.
Best regrow crops → Kegs. Blueberry Wine ~1,500g Artisan per batch. Volume compensates for lower unit price.
Hops regrow DAILY in Summer. 10 Kegs produce 4,200g Artisan Pale Ale every 7 days. Cheap seed → high output ratio.
Fairy Rose honey: 680g Artisan each. 40+ Bee Houses earns 27,000g per 4-day cycle — fully passive.
Mariner removes all trash. 30 pots × ~100g avg catch = 3,000g/day completely passive with zero effort.
Best active income: Catfish on rainy days (200g+), Crimsonfish in Summer (1,500g). Expert session = 3,000–8,000g.
Cheese, Goat Cheese, Duck Mayo — consistent artisan income once Barn/Coop is fully upgraded with Auto-Petter.
Before Kegs, Preserve Jars double crop value. 20 jars running constantly = solid mid-game income.
30+ Maple Trees × 200g Artisan Syrup every 9 days = 600–800g/day passive with no maintenance.
Selling crops without processing. +10% with Tiller. Always better to process, but raw sales are better than nothing early.
Inconsistent but big payouts. Diamonds (750g), Rubies/Emeralds (250g). Sell surplus after gifting needs are met.
Active income from deep runs. Iridium Bars (1,000g each), Gems, Prismatic Shards (2,000g). Luck-dependent.
Selling forage items without processing. Fine early but always use for bundles and gifts first. Botanist helps value.
Almost never worth selling. You always need more of these than you think.
